description: Weaviate client keyed from process.env / os.environ in both the TS search module and the Python ingest script, plus two files that only name the key: a map from env vars to Google Secret Manager secret IDs ("WEAVIATE_API_KEY": "weaviate-api-key-production") and a ternary choosing which env var to read. The safe counterpart to VC175 — must NOT fire.
